summary.text: Myriad Statue Palace is an Immortal Gu House deep below Western Desert's myriad statue desert. Thousand Transformations Ancestor relies on it while enduring a rank eight myriad tribulation.

claims.text: Palace walls absorb the sound waves of Thousand Transformations Ancestor’s screams so the commotion cannot be felt outside. Thick chains coil around him and later shoot from the walls to capture year beasts that cutting flesh transformation produces from his body. He judges that without this Immortal Gu House left behind by Reckless Savage Demon Venerable, he would not have survived the first myriad tribulation at all.
Deviation (recorded): this page is filed under gu-houses because Myriad Statue Palace is a named Immortal Gu House. It is tied to myriad statue desert but is not itself a five-region map seat.

During a fight involving a false twin of Thousand Transformations Ancestor, Fang Yuan concludes that the earlier “Ancestor” was formed by Myriad Statue Palace, with the real Night Temptress assisting inside the house while the real Thousand Transformations Ancestor hid among the concubines. From his first life of five hundred years, during the five regions chaotic war, he already knew this Immortal Gu House’s secret: unlike other Immortal Gu Houses, Myriad Statue Palace can transform into the appearance of every statue created inside it and copy that being’s innate abilities and methods. He treats the false Myriad Transformations Ancestor as the palace in human form, so the house and Thousand Transformations Ancestor cannot truly separate.

At the Central Continent Refinement Path Convention battlefield, a grand Immortal Gu House larger than Divine Bean Palace enters with giant red-gold bricks, black-gold tiles, and countless lifelike statues embedded on its surface. It is named rank eight Immortal Gu House Myriad Statue Palace, and Thousand Transformations Ancestor’s voice comes from within as he joins Western Desert’s side.
